qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the constitution of Legislatures in States?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्यों में विधानमंडलों के गठन का प्रावधान करता है?
o: Article 170
Article 168
Article 171
Article 172
e: Article 168 kehta hai ki har State ke liye ek Legislature hoga jisme Governor shamil honge aur jahan do Houses hain wahan Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) aur Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) dono shamil honge.

qe: How many States in India currently possess a bicameral legislature with both a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council?
qh: वर्तमान में भारत के कितने राज्यों में द्विसदनीय विधानमंडल (विधानसभा और विधान परिषद) है?
o: 5 States
7 States
8 States
6 States
e: Currently 6 states me bicameral legislature hai: Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, aur Telangana. Jammu & Kashmir ke reorganization ke baad wahan ki Legislative Council abolish ho gayi thi.

qe: Under Article 170 of the Constitution, what is the maximum permissible numerical strength of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 170 के अनुसार राज्य विधानसभा की अधिकतम अनुमेय सदस्य संख्या क्या है?
o: 403 members
500 members
450 members
550 members
e: Article 170 ke mutabiq kisi bhi State Legislative Assembly me direct election se chune jane wale members ki sankhya maximum 500 aur minimum 60 ho sakti hai (Goa, Sikkim, aur Mizoram jaise chote states ke liye special constitutional exceptions hain).

qe: What is the minimum constitutional age requirement to become a Member of the Legislative Council (MLC) in a State?
qh: किसी राज्य में विधान परिषद का सदस्य (MLC) बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु क्या निर्धारित है?
o: 21 years
25 years
35 years
30 years
e: Article 173 ke tehat Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) ka sadasya banne ke liye minimum age 25 years honi chahiye, jabki Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad) ka member banne ke liye 30 years anivarya hai.

qe: Who holds the final, non-justiciable authority to certify whether a legislative bill in a State is a 'Money Bill' under Article 199?
qh: राज्य विधानमंडल में कोई विधेयक 'धन विधेयक' है या नहीं, इसे प्रमाणित करने का अंतिम अधिकार किसके पास है?
o: The Governor of the State
The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chief Minister
The Chairman of the Legislative Council
e: Article 199(3) ke mutabiq agar ye sawal uthe ki koi State Bill Money Bill hai ya nahi, toh Vidhan Sabha ke Speaker ka decision final hota hai aur use kisi court ya council me challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Under Article 169 of the Constitution, which institution is empowered to abolish or create a State Legislative Council?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 169 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का सृजन या उत्सादन करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: Parliament by Law, following a special majority resolution by the State Legislative Assembly
The Governor through an executive ordinance
The State Legislative Assembly acting alone
The President of India on Cabinet advice
e: Article 169 ke tehat agar State Legislative Assembly total membership ke majority aur present & voting ke 2/3rd majority se resolution pass kare, toh Parliament simple majority law banakar wahan Legislative Council bana ya hata sakti hai.

qe: Under Article 171, the total membership of a State Legislative Council cannot exceed what proportion of the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 के तहत विधान परिषद के सदस्यों की कुल संख्या विधानसभा की कुल सदस्य संख्या के कितने भाग से अधिक नहीं हो सकती?
o: One-fourth (1/4th)
One-half (1/2)
One-third (1/3rd)
One-fifth (1/5th)
e: Article 171(1) ke anusar Legislative Council ki strength Legislative Assembly ki total seats ke 1/3rd se zyada nahi ho sakti, lekin kisi bhi halat me ye strength 40 members se kam nahi honi chahiye.

qe: Under Article 189(3), what is the statutory quorum required to constitute a valid meeting of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 189(3) के अनुसार राज्य विधानसभा की बैठक के लिए आवश्यक वैधानिक कोरम क्या है?
o: 10 members or one-tenth (1/10th) of the total members of the House, whichever is greater
Strictly 15 members
One-fifth of the total membership
One-twentieth of the total membership
e: Article 189(3) ke mutabiq State Legislature ke kisi bhi House me meeting tabhi conduct ho sakti hai jab kam se kam 10 members ya House ke total sadasyo ka 1/10th (jo bhi zyada ho) present hon.

qe: Who elects the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly under Article 178?
qh: अनुच्छेद 178 के तहत राज्य विधानसभा के अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष का चुनाव कौन करता है?
o: The Governor of the State
The members of the Legislative Assembly from amongst themselves
The Chief Minister and Council of Ministers
Joint sitting of both Houses of the State Legislature
e: Article 178 ke tehat Legislative Assembly ke sabhi elected MLAs apne beech me se hi ek member ko Speaker aur dusre member ko Deputy Speaker elect karte hain.

qe: What is the maximum duration for which a State Legislative Council can delay a Money Bill passed by the Assembly?
qh: राज्य विधान परिषद विधानसभा द्वारा पारित धन विधेयक को अधिकतम कितने समय तक रोक सकती है?
o: 30 days
14 days
3 months
6 months
e: Article 198 ke tehat Money Bill sirf Vidhan Sabha me introduce hota hai. Vidhan Parishad use reject ya amend nahi kar sakti; wo sirf 14 days tak recommendations ke liye rok sakti hai, jiske baad bill automatically pass maan liya jata hai.

qe: What is the constitutional duration and renewal cycle of a State Legislative Council under Article 172(2)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 172(2) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का कार्यकाल और नवीनीकरण चक्र क्या है?
o: It dissolves every 5 years along with the Assembly
It is a permanent body not subject to dissolution, with one-third of its members retiring every second year (individual term of 6 years)
Fixed tenure of 6 years after which the entire council is dissolved
Subject to annual re-election by local bodies
e: Vidhan Parishad Rajya Sabha ki tarah ek permanent house hai jo kabhi bhang nahi hota. Iske sadasyo ka tenure 6 saal hota hai aur har do saal me 1/3rd members retire ho jaate hain.

qe: Under Article 174, who holds the constitutional authority to summon, prorogue, and dissolve the State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 174 के तहत राज्य विधानसभा के सत्र को आहूत करने, सत्रावसान करने और भंग करने का अधिकार किसे है?
o: The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chief Minister
The Governor of the State
The President of India
e: Article 174 ke tehat Governor Council of Ministers ki advice par session bulata (summon) hai, session samapt (prorogue) karta hai aur Legislative Assembly ko dissolve karne ki power rakhta hai.

qe: What proportion of members in a State Legislative Council are nominated directly by the Governor under Article 171?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद में कितने अनुपात में सदस्य राज्यपाल द्वारा सीधे मनोनीत किए जाते हैं?
o: One-third (1/3rd)
One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-sixth (1/6th) of the total members
Fixed at 12 members
e: Article 171(3)(e) aur 171(5) ke tehat Governor Council ki total strength ka 1/6th hissa Literature, Science, Art, Co-operative Movement aur Social Service ke experts me se nominate karta hai.

qe: If a deadlock arises between the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council over an Ordinary Bill, how is it resolved under the Constitution?
qh: साधारण विधेयक पर विधानसभा और विधान परिषद के बीच गतिरोध उत्पन्न होने पर संविधान के तहत इसका समाधान कैसे किया जाता है?
o: Through a joint sitting of both Houses presided by the Speaker
The will of the Legislative Assembly prevails, as the Constitution does not provide for a joint sitting in State Legislatures
The Governor acts as arbitrator and passes binding orders
The bill is permanently abandoned
e: State Legislatures ke liye Constitution me Joint Sitting ka koi provision nahi hai. Agar Vidhan Parishad bill ko reject karde ya 3 mahine roke, aur Assembly use dobara pass karde, toh Parishad use maximum 1 mahina aur rok sakti hai, jiske baad bill dono houses se pass maan liya jata hai.

qe: Who served as the first Speaker of the Bihar Legislative Assembly in 1937?
qh: 1937 में बिहार विधानसभा के पहले अध्यक्ष के रूप में किसने कार्य किया था?
o: Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha
Ram Dayalu Singh
Vindheshwari Prasad Varma
Deep Narayan Singh
e: Government of India Act 1935 ke baad 1937 me bani Bihar Legislative Assembly ke pehle Speaker Ram Dayalu Singh the aur Deputy Speaker Professor Abdul Bari the. Post-independence pehle Speaker Vindheshwari Prasad Varma the.

qe: Under Article 192, who decides questions regarding the disqualification of a sitting member of the State Legislature (other than on grounds of defection)?
qh: दलबदल के अलावा, राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी सदस्य की अयोग्यता के प्रश्नों पर अंतिम निर्णय कौन लेता है?
o: The Speaker or Chairman of the respective House
The High Court having territorial jurisdiction
The Governor, acting according to the binding opinion of the Election Commission of India
The State Law Minister
e: Article 192 ke tehat Office of Profit, unsound mind ya statutory disqualification par final decision Governor leta hai, jisme Election Commission of India (ECI) se opinion lena aur use maanna legally binding hota hai.

qe: To whom does the Chairman of a State Legislative Council submit their written resignation under Article 183?
qh: अनुच्छेद 183 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का सभापति अपना त्यागपत्र किसे सौंपता है?
o: The Governor of the State
The Deputy Chairman of the Legislative Council
The Chief Minister
The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
e: Article 183(b) ke mutabiq Legislative Council ka Chairman apna resignation Deputy Chairman ko address karta hai, aur Deputy Chairman apna resignation Chairman ko deta hai.

qe: What proportion of members of the Legislative Council are elected by the members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) under Article 171(3)(d)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(d) के तहत विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य विधानसभा सदस्यों (MLAs) द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-sixth (1/6th)
One-third (1/3rd)
One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-fourth (1/4th)
e: Article 171(3)(d) ke tehat Legislative Council ki total seats ka 1/3rd portion Legislative Assembly ke MLAs dwara proportional representation with single transferable vote ke zariye chuna jata hai.

qe: Under Article 171(3)(b), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by the graduates constituency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(b) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य स्नातक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-twelfth (1/12th) elected by persons who have been graduates for at least 3 years
One-sixth elected by university professors
One-third elected by registered degree holders
One-fourth elected by state bar councils
e: Article 171(3)(b) ke tehat Council ke 1/12th members un citizens dwara chune jaate hain jo kam se kam 3 saal pehle kisi recognized university se graduate ho chuke hon.

qe: Under Article 171(3)(c), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by the teachers constituency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(c) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य शिक्षक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-sixth (1/6th)
One-twelfth (1/12th) elected by persons engaged in teaching for at least 3 years in secondary schools or higher
One-third (1/3rd)
Fixed quota of 10 teachers
e: Article 171(3)(c) ke anusar Council ke 1/12th sadasya un teachers dwara chune jaate hain jo state ke secondary schools, colleges ya universities me kam se kam 3 saal se teaching profession me hon.

qe: What is the minimum statutory membership floor fixed by Article 171 for any State Legislative Council?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 द्वारा किसी भी राज्य विधान परिषद के लिए न्यूनतम सदस्य संख्या क्या निर्धारित है?
o: 30 members
50 members
40 members
60 members
e: Article 171(1) proviso specify karta hai ki kisi bhi state ki Legislative Council me members ki total sankhya kisi bhi sthiti me 40 se kam nahi ho sakti.

qe: Under Article 210, what constitutional provision governs the languages used for transacting business in State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 210 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडलों में कार्य संचालन की भाषा के संबंध में क्या प्रावधान है?
o: Strictly the official language or languages of the State, or Hindi, or English
Exclusively English in all proceedings
Only the regional mother tongue of the Chief Minister
Sanskrit or Hindi exclusively
e: Article 210 ke mutabiq State Legislature ka kaam state ki official language, Hindi ya English me ho sakta hai. Presiding Officer kisi sadasya ko apni mother tongue me House ko address karne ki permission bhi de sakta hai.

qe: What is the maximum total time an Ordinary Bill passed by the Legislative Assembly can be delayed by the Legislative Council across all stages?
qh: विधानसभा द्वारा पारित किसी साधारण विधेयक को विधान परिषद दोनों चरणों में मिलाकर अधिकतम कितने समय तक रोक सकती है?
o: Maximum 3 months
Maximum 6 months
Maximum 4 months (3 months in first instance + 1 month in second instance)
Indefinitely
e: Article 197 ke tehat Legislative Council pehli baar me bill ko 3 months tak rok sakti hai. Agar Assembly use dobara pass kar de, toh Council use maximum 1 month aur delay kar sakti hai (total combined limit 4 months).

qe: Article 212 of the Constitution explicitly places which restriction on the judiciary regarding State Legislatures?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 212 राज्य विधानमंडलों के संबंध में न्यायपालिका पर क्या रोक लगाता है?
o: Courts cannot strike down state tax laws
The validity of any proceedings in the Legislature of a State shall not be called in question in any court on the ground of any alleged irregularity of procedure
High Court cannot issue writs against state ministers
Judges cannot contest state municipal elections
e: Article 212 separation of powers ko protect karta hai: State Legislature ke andar ki proceedings ya voting process me procedural irregularity ke basis par koi bhi court inquiry nahi kar sakta.

qe: How did the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2020 affect the composition of the State Legislative Assemblies?
qh: 104वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2020 ने राज्य विधानसभाओं की संरचना को कैसे प्रभावित किया?
o: Increased reservation for tribal areas
Abolished the Governor's power under Article 333 to nominate one Anglo-Indian member to the Legislative Assembly
Lowered the assembly membership age to 21 years
Mandated proportional representation in state cabinets
e: Article 333 ke tehat pehle Governor ko Legislative Assembly me 1 Anglo-Indian member nominate karne ka right tha. January 2020 me 104th Amendment ne is nomination quota ko aage extend na karke discontinue kar diya.

qe: Under Article 171(3)(a), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by local authorities (Municipalities, District Boards)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(a) के तहत विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों (नगर पालिकाओं, जिला बोर्डों) द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-third (1/3rd)
One-sixth (1/6th)
One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-fourth (1/4th)
e: Article 171(3)(a) ke tehat Council ki total seats ka lagbhag 1/3rd hissa local authorities (jaise Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, Zila Parishads) ke elected representatives dwara chuna jata hai.

qe: Under Article 187, what structural provision is made for the secretarial staff of State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 187 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के सचिवालयीय कर्मचारियों के लिए क्या व्यवस्था की गई है?
o: Each House of the State Legislature shall have a separate secretarial staff independent of the executive government
Staff is borrowed directly from the central Lok Sabha secretariat
Secretariat is managed directly by the State Public Service Commission
The Governor personal staff handles all assembly files
e: Article 187 mandate karta hai ki Vidhan Sabha aur Vidhan Parishad dono ka apna alag, autonomous secretarial staff hoga jiske recruitment rules State Legislature kanoon banakar regulate karti hai.

qe: Under Article 203(3), on whose recommendation alone can a 'Demand for Grant' be moved in the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 203(3) के तहत विधानसभा में 'अनुदान की मांग' किसकी सिफारिश पर ही पेश की जा सकती है?
o: The Speaker of the Assembly
The Chief Minister
The Governor of the State
The Leader of Opposition
e: Article 203(3) ke mutabiq koi bhi Demand for Grant tabhi Assembly me vote ke liye put ki ja sakti hai jab uske liye Governor ki prior recommendation prapt ho.

qe: Under Article 189(1), what is the nature of the voting power exercised by the Speaker of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 189(1) के तहत विधानसभा अध्यक्ष द्वारा प्रयोग की जाने वाली मतदान शक्ति की प्रकृति क्या है?
o: The Speaker votes in the first instance on all state bills
The Speaker does not vote in the first instance, but exercises a casting vote only in the case of an equality of votes (tie)
The Speaker has two votes on constitutional resolutions
The Speaker can cast a proxy vote on behalf of the Chief Minister
e: Presiding officer neutral umpire hota hai isliye wo normal voting me participate nahi karta. Lekin agar 'Ayes' aur 'Noes' barabar ho jayein (tie), toh deadlock break karne ke liye Article 189 ke tehat Casting Vote use karta hai.

qe: Under Article 180, who performs the duties of the office of Speaker when both the offices of Speaker and Deputy Speaker are vacant?
qh: अनुच्छेद 180 के तहत जब अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष दोनों के पद रिक्त हों, तब अध्यक्ष के कर्तव्यों का पालन कौन करता है?
o: The Chief Minister ex-officio
Such member of the Assembly as the Governor may appoint for the purpose
The senior-most member of the Legislative Council
The Secretary of the Legislative Assembly
e: Article 180(1) ke anusar jab Speaker aur Deputy Speaker dono offices vacant ho jayein, toh Governor Assembly ke kisi sadasya ko duties perform karne ke liye appoint karta hai.

qe: What core parliamentary immunities are conferred upon state legislators and the Advocate General under Article 194?
qh: अनुच्छेद 194 के तहत राज्य के विधायकों और महाधिवक्ता को क्या मुख्य संसदीय उन्मुक्तियां प्राप्त हैं?
o: Freedom of speech in the Legislature and immunity from court proceedings for anything said or any vote given in the House or its committees
Immunity from arrest in criminal homicide cases
Complete exemption from state motor vehicle regulations
Right to veto High Court judicial verdicts
e: Article 194 legislators aur Advocate General ko complete judicial immunity deta hai: Legislature ya uski kisi committee me unke dwara kahi gayi baat ya vote par kisi court me proceedings nahi chalai ja sakti.

qe: Under Article 204, how can money be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund of the State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 204 के तहत राज्य की संचित निधि से धन की निकासी कैसे की जा सकती है?
o: Through an executive sanction signed by the Chief Minister
Only pursuant to an Appropriation Act passed by the State Legislature
By an order of the State Accountant General
Through an ordinance without legislative ratification
e: Article 204(3) ke mutabiq State Legislature dwara Appropriation Act pass kiye bina Consolidated Fund of the State se koi bhi dhan nikalna kanoonan impossible hai.

qe: Under Article 190(2), what is the rule regarding simultaneous membership in Parliament and a State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 190(2) के तहत संसद और राज्य विधानमंडल की एक साथ दोहरी सदस्यता के संबंध में क्या नियम है?
o: A person can hold both seats indefinitely
If a person is elected to both, they must resign from the State Legislature within 14 days, failing which their State seat becomes vacant
The seat in Parliament becomes vacant automatically within 24 hours
The Governor decides which seat the member shall retain
e: Prohibition of Simultaneous Membership Rules ke tehat agar koi MLA/MLC Parliament ke liye elect ho jata hai, toh use 14 days ke andar state seat se resign karna padta hai, warna uski state legislature ki seat automatically vacant ho jaati hai.

qe: What is the maximum permissible time interval between two consecutive sessions of a State Legislature under Article 174?
qh: अनुच्छेद 174 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम कितना अंतराल मान्य है?
o: 3 months
6 months
9 months
1 year
e: Article 174(1) mandate karta hai ki ek session ki last sitting aur next session ki first sitting ke beech 6 months se zyada ka gap nahi hona chahiye. Iska matlab saal me kam se kam do sessions anivarya hain.

qe: When the State Legislative Assembly is dissolved, does the Speaker immediately vacate office?
qh: जब राज्य विधानसभा भंग होती है, तो क्या विधानसभा अध्यक्ष तुरंत पद छोड़ देता है?
o: Yes, the office falls vacant immediately upon dissolution
No, the Speaker shall not vacate their office until immediately before the first meeting of the new Assembly
The Speaker hands over charge to the Governor within 24 hours
The Chief Minister assumes the administrative charge of the House
e: Article 179 proviso clearly states ki Assembly dissolve hone par bhi Speaker apna office tab tak vacate nahi karta jab tak nayi Assembly ki pehli meeting shuru na ho jaye, taaki legislative continuity bani rahe.

qe: Under Article 200, when a Bill passed by the State Legislature is presented to the Governor, what constitutional courses of action are available?
qh: अनुच्छेद 200 के तहत जब कोई विधेयक राज्यपाल के समक्ष प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, तो उनके पास क्या विकल्प होते हैं?
o: Assent to the bill, withhold assent, return the bill (if not a Money Bill) for reconsideration, or reserve the bill for the consideration of the President
Only assent or reject within 14 days
Refer the bill directly to the Supreme Court for legal vetting
Dissolve the legislative council automatically
e: Article 200 Governor ko 4 options deta hai: wo assent de sakta hai, assent withhold kar sakta hai, non-money bill ko reconsideration ke liye return kar sakta hai, ya President ke consideration ke liye reserve kar sakta hai (jaise agar bill High Court ki powers affect kare).

qe: Under the Representation of the People Act, 1951, what is the mandatory timeframe for holding a by-election to fill a casual vacancy in the Legislature?
qh: लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम 1951 के तहत विधानमंडल में आकस्मिक रिक्ति को भरने के लिए उपचुनाव कराने की समय-सीमा क्या है?
o: Within 3 months
Within 6 months from the date of occurrence of the vacancy (unless the remainder of the term is less than 1 year)
Within 1 year
At the sole discretion of the State Cabinet
e: RPA 1951 ke Section 151A ke mutabiq vacancy create hone ke 6 months ke andar Election Commission ko by-election karwana hota hai, basharte seat ka remaining term kam se kam 1 year bacha ho.

qe: In the Bihar Legislative Assembly (total 243 seats), what is the statutory reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)?
qh: बिहार विधानसभा (कुल 243 सीटें) में अनुसूचित जातियों (SC) और अनुसूचित जनजातियों (ST) के लिए सीटों का आरक्षण क्या है?
o: 38 seats reserved for SC and 2 seats reserved for ST
40 seats for SC and 5 seats for ST
35 seats for SC and zero seats for ST
25 seats for SC and 10 seats for ST
e: Delimitation Commission order ke mutabiq Bihar Vidhan Sabha me 38 seats Scheduled Castes (SC) ke liye reserved hain aur 2 seats (Katoria aur Manihari) Scheduled Tribes (ST) ke liye reserved hain.

qe: Under Article 186, who determines the salaries and allowances of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 186 के तहत विधानसभा अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष के वेतन और भत्तों का निर्धारण कौन करता है?
o: The Governor of the State through executive order
The State Legislature by Law
The Union Parliament
The State High Court Registrar
e: Article 186 ke tehat Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Chairman aur Deputy Chairman ke salaries aur allowances State Legislature kanoon enact karke tay karti hai, aur ye kharch State Consolidated Fund par charged hota hai.

qe: What is the total sanctioned membership strength of the Bihar Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
qh: बिहार विधान परिषद की कुल स्वीकृत सदस्य संख्या कितनी है?
o: 60 members
75 members
81 members
95 members
e: Bihar Legislative Council ki total strength 75 members hai: jisme 27 MLAs dwara, 24 local authorities dwara, 6 graduates dwara, 6 teachers dwara elect hote hain aur 12 Governor dwara nominate hote hain.

qe: Under Article 172(1), who has the power to extend the 5-year duration of the State Legislative Assembly during a Proclamation of National Emergency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 172(1) के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान राज्य विधानसभा के 5 वर्ष के कार्यकाल को बढ़ाने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: The State Governor by proclamation
Parliament by Law, for a period not exceeding one year at a time
The Chief Minister with Cabinet approval
The Supreme Court of India
e: Article 172(1) proviso ke tehat National Emergency (Art 352) ke dauran Parliament law pass karke Legislative Assembly ke term ko ek baar me 1 saal ke liye extend kar sakti hai (emergency khatam hone ke 6 months baad ye extension continue nahi reh sakta).

qe: Under Article 177, what special procedural right is conferred upon Ministers and the Advocate General in bicameral State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 177 के तहत मंत्रियों और महाधिवक्ता को द्विसदनीय राज्य विधानमंडलों में क्या विशेष प्रक्रियात्मक अधिकार प्राप्त है?
o: The right to speak and take part in the proceedings of both Houses and any committee, but the right to vote only in the House of which they are a member (Advocate General cannot vote)
The right to vote in both Houses simultaneously
Immunity from all legislative motions
Power to dissolve either House unilaterally
e: Article 177 ke tehat State Minister chahe Assembly ka member ho ya Council ka, wo dono Houses ki proceedings me baith sakta aur bol sakta hai. Par voting wo sirf usi House me kar sakta hai jiska wo elected/nominated member hai. Advocate General dono houses me bol sakta hai par vote bilkul nahi de sakta.

qe: Under Article 181, can the Speaker preside over the Assembly while a resolution for their own removal from office is under consideration?
qh: अनुच्छेद 181 के तहत, क्या अध्यक्ष तब विधानसभा की अध्यक्षता कर सकता है जब उसे पद से हटाने का प्रस्ताव विचाराधीन हो?
o: Yes, the Speaker retains full presiding authority until the final vote is cast
No, the Speaker shall not preside, though they have the right to speak and take part in the proceedings and vote in the first instance (but not in case of equality of votes)
The Speaker is barred from entering the assembly hall
The Governor automatically presides over the sitting
e: Article 181 mandate karta hai ki removal resolution ke time Speaker chair par nahi baith sakta. Wo proceedings me participate kar sakta hai aur first instance me vote de sakta hai, par casting vote (tie-breaker) use nahi kar sakta.

qe: If a member elected to a State Legislature is expelled from their political party, does it automatically trigger disqualification from the House under the Tenth Schedule?
qh: यदि राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी सदस्य को उसके राजनीतिक दल से निष्कासित कर दिया जाता है, तो क्या 10वीं अनुसूची के तहत वह स्वतः अयोग्य हो जाता है?
o: Yes, expulsion by party automatically vacates the legislative seat
No, party expulsion does not amount to voluntarily giving up party membership; the member remains an unattached member in the House
Yes, if ratified by the Governor within 7 days
Disqualification applies only if the member joins the ruling party
e: Supreme Court rulings (G. Viswanathan case) ke mutabiq party dwara 'expel' kiye jane par MP/MLA disqualify nahi hota kyunki usne voluntarily party nahi chhodi hai. Disqualification tabhi hoti hai jab member khud resign kare ya House me party whip violate kare.

qe: Under Article 329, what is the constitutional procedure for challenging the validity of any election to the State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 329 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी चुनाव की वैधता को चुनौती देने की संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया क्या है?
o: Through a direct administrative petition to the Governor
Only by an Election Petition presented to the High Court as provided by the Representation of the People Act, 1951
Through an appeal before the State Human Rights Commission
By an inquiry conducted by the District Collector
e: Article 329(b) ke anusar kisi bhi election result ko regular civil suit se challenge nahi kiya ja sakta; election results ko challenge karne ka sole method RPA 1951 ke tehat State High Court me Election Petition file karna hota hai.
